subject: Materials Science
title: The p-n Junction: Where Magic Happens
description: A quick, practical guide to The p-n Junction: Where Magic Happens.

hook.text: Put n-type next to p-type silicon and a depletion region forms — a built-in electric field at the boundary.

buildup.text: Electrons from n-side diffuse into p-side, holes diffuse the other way — they recombine at the junction.

discovery.text: The exposed dopant ions create a space-charge region — an internal voltage barrier that stops further diffusion.

twist.text: Apply forward voltage and the barrier shrinks — current floods through. Reverse voltage widens it — current stops.

climax.text: The p-n junction is the heart of every diode, transistor, solar cell, and LED ever made.

punchline.text: Two types of doped silicon meeting at a boundary created the information age.

quiz.question: What forms at a p-n junction?
options: A metallic bond between the two sides
A depletion region with a built-in electric field
A vacuum gap between the materials
